# #1573: Patch: the duos fuzz varies team rules, handicaps and dealt decks
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The co-op fuzz gate plays the same default setup on every seed — the humans' team rules, no handicaps, never a dealt deck — so the configurations production actually runs (AI-team rules per difficulty, handicapped seats, dealt-deck duels) are fuzzed not at all. After this, the seed varies those options the way the 1v1 fuzz already rotates handicaps and starts.

## Why
`play_duos_game_inner` builds `DuosCreateOptions` with only `seed` and generated decks, leaving `teams`, `handicaps`, `dealt` and `custom_cards` at `Default` (`crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs:253-264`). The dealt-seat filter inside `create_duel` (`crates/engine/src/duos/state.rs`) has no coverage anywhere — the rules tests hardcode `dealt: None` — and the non-`DUOS_HUMAN_TEAM` rules change pass costs and pool health the co-op AI reads (§13.7).

## Proposal
Rotate `teams`, per-seat `handicaps` and `dealt` by seed, the way `handicap_for_seed` and the 1v1 `StartKind` rotation already do; print the options in a failure's report beside the seed and decks so a failure stays reproducible.

## Where it lands
`crates/tools/src/duos_fuzz.rs`; spec §13.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Two seeds produce different create options (a unit test pins the rotation)
- [ ] At least one rotation exercises a dealt seat, covering the `create_duel` filter
- [ ] Failure reports name the options alongside seed and decks

## Size and risks
Small-medium; mirror of machinery the 1v1 fuzz already has. Custom cards stay out of scope (custom-card fuzz was rejected in #1000).
